title: AbOptimizer reinforcement learning edits therapeutic antibody sequences
summary: AbOptimizer uses reinforcement learning to choose editing sites and actions and protein language models to recommend mutations, with surrogate evaluation and Pareto rewards. On three therapeutic antibodies it improved optimized properties in silico; in vitro, selected variants showed affinity-specificity co-optimization for emibetuzumab, improved affinity and specificity with largely maintained thermal stability for siltuximab, and affinity optimization including indels for trastuzumab.
ai_technology: AbOptimizer reinforcement-learning framework with protein language models for antibody sequence editing
